_comment: Copy this to sources.json and fill in your own IDs.
Channel and guild IDs come from Discord with Developer Mode turned on
(User Settings -> Advanced -> Developer Mode), then right-click a channel
or the server icon and choose Copy ID.
YouTube channel IDs start with UC. To find one from a @handle, run:

youtube._filter_note: Add "filter": false to take everything this channel posts.

_comment: Only uploads whose TITLE matches reach the Videos tab. Matching is
case-insensitive with word boundaries, and the words of a phrase may
run together, so 'midtown madness' also matches '#midtownmadness'.
Exclusions are checked first and reject outright.
Omit this block entirely to use the built-in Madness defaults;
supplying 'match' REPLACES those defaults rather than adding to them.
Every rejected title is printed in the run log, so the filter can be
tuned by reading what it threw away.
